lane: WBG-8 registry-inverted truth model + metric-optimal emission
hypothesis: H3c: the plateau is coverage-limited, not habitat-limited; at matched count and coverage the only free lever is placing each dot on the most prospective pixel within +-2 px, which converts metric misses into hits at zero FP cost
mechanism: score-weighted registry dot density smoothed to 2 km (x 0.2 H1 habitat) as a tie-break field inside each 11 px lattice cell, then a 3 px square guard enforcing >=7 px = 2R+1 separation in habitat order
non_fault_mimic: a lattice is a lattice: the macro-geometry is inherited from the plateau files by design; the only new information is the consensus habitat's local ranking, whose 1.64x enrichment was never validated as a precision multiplier; inherits GEMS-57 label bias through the consensus
submission_note: H3c: 42,771 kernel-disjoint dots, 11 px lattice, each on its local consensus maximum. MODEL-ESTIMATE 0.23-0.35. Break-even hit rate 12 pct.

validator.upload_authorization: not evaluated by a format validator; separate scientific selector required
validator.scope: Format only; this does not certify bias audit, holdout promotion or weekly-slot eligibility

official_template_grid_and_footprint.detail: Template must be the pinned organizer grid, not just a self-consistent arbitrary raster

variant_strict_whole_array_no_nan_allowe.detail: ((a>=0)&(a<=1)).all() over the whole array - fails for ANY NaN, including the official sample's NaN outside

profile_matches_official_sample.detail: driver/dtype/nodata/size/crs/transform equal to template; compress=lzw (template lzw)

tail: "warning": "FORMAT PASS is not uniqueness, scientific efficacy, organizer acceptance or slot approval."

registry_uniqueness.known_instrument_defect: the literal >70% within-3px rule is degenerate against dense registries (documented in AGENTS.md 0b(ii)); the density-matched lift is the informative number

holdout.instrument_defect: this catalogue proxy is documented NOT to rank real submissions (Spearman 0.144, p=0.12, n=118); it is a diagnostic, never a score estimate

leakage_canary.definition: AUC of each habitat field alone, withheld catalogue pixels vs fold background

score_estimate.uncertainty_source: leave-one-family-out MAE of the same estimator on the 118 owner-reported scores

null_floor.definition: same estimator applied to a density-matched random off-catalogue field

metric_identity.identity: for a kernel-disjoint dot field DTI = TP_w / (0.2*N + 0.8*K + 0.2*(TP_w - A)) with A = sum over dots of each dot's own best kernel credit; since A <= TP_w the naive form TP_w/(0.2N+0.8K) overstates by under 1% here (measured 0.014296 exact vs 0.014309 naive with metric.py:dti_exact on labels.tif as a proxy truth), which is below the registry noise floor of 0.0175

verified_on.note: 6,436 dots removed, all within 2 px of the visible catalogue, 0 added (exact ancestry in evidence/h33_b2_forensics.json); the identity says that pruning cost ~24 units of credit and bought +0.0178 of score, which is the same conclusion the forensics file reached independently

metric_identity.unidentified_parameter: K and the hit rate are not separately identified: TP_w/K is pinned by the score, so K=8,441 would reproduce 0.2778 from 3,968 full-credit hits instead. The registry cannot choose between them; the WBG-6 null calibration's K=12,395 is used here
metric_identity.consequence_for_us: at N=42,771 the denominator is 0.2*42771+0.8*12395 = 18,470, so beating 0.2778 needs TP_w > 5,131 against the champion's 4,847: a 6% credit gain, i.e. ~290 extra hits, which is what the micro-placement is for

gate_semantics.unique_literal_overlap: measured max 3-px overlap is against the densest registry raster, which covers 40% of the footprint with its own buffer; documented degenerate (AGENTS.md 0b(ii))
gate_semantics.unique_surface_spearman: IR-WBG8-02, found in this run: Spearman between two 0/1 dot surfaces is a monotone function of their overlap, so on binary submissions it measures the same thing as the 3-px gate and cannot identify copying. It is meaningful only for continuous probability surfaces (the organizer's reference U-Net output)
gate_semantics.density_matched_lift_below_2x: lift > 2 means 'more concentrated than chance at the same density'; for a field built from the registry's own consensus that is expected and is not a copy signal
gate_semantics.beats_holdout_instrument_best_of_118: the shared hide-and-recover proxy is documented NOT to rank real submissions (Spearman 0.144, p=0.12, n=118) and rewards overlap with the visible catalogue, which every plateau file avoids by design

decision.explicit: the organizer portal is the only authority on a score; this project never uploads
